Ember Edge

You lift the weapon and watch a red gleam travel along its working edge.

Rules

ID: item-ember-edge. Status: Proposal — special equipment. Form: A melee weapon. Bulk: 1.

Requirements: Flame 1; understanding not required. Action: Passive unless the effect says otherwise.

Adds 1 fire damage to attacks made with it. On Strong also applies Burning 1. Cannot apply to ranged attacks.

Apply this item’s printed benefit only; it grants no ability or action beyond what it states. No DP purchase; found or bought when the DA makes it available. No special recipe is supplied by owning it.

Equipment index

Market price: 400 coins (special-order benchmark; availability is not guaranteed). Proposal; see @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a8b099af3500d9f6.JournalEntryPage.cfa94361944ba875]{market rules}.
